scripts.dev: concurrently --names student,staff,admin --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend/student" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/staff" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend/student && npm run build --prefix frontend/staff && npm run build --prefix frontend/admin
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend/student && npm install --prefix frontend/staff && npm install --prefix frontend/admin
